text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, during an outing to the next town over,
Buena Vista and I were eating at a soba shop we'd never visited before.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal, sir!
The soba was truly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks, young lady.
It makes me happy to hear ya say that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes! The soba had such a rich aroma, with just the right touch of sweetness. I was truly moved...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll come visit again soon!
Fufu. That's one more thing to look forward to♪

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: ...I just wonder if the shop will hold out until then...

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Sorry about that.
To be honest, business has been tough lately.
I might have to... close up shop soon.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
......Is that right...?
It's such a lovely shop, too... What a shame.

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Without new customers, a business won't survive.
...If I can just get 'em to eat it, I'm confident I can win their hearts, though...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
――! In that case...
won't you let me promote this shop!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll spread the word around the shopping street... and make flyers too!
I want more people to know just how delicious this soba is!

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Little lady...! You're right, you're totally right!
The shop's still standing... I gotta do everything I can!
—Let's get out there and promote it together!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Come try our shopping district's famous soba~!
It's absolutely delicious,
so please stop on by~!

text_block_list.name: Passing Woman
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's Buena-chan!
Buena-chan's recommendation... I'm definitely going!
Oh, I'll tell my friends about it too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Thank you so much!
I'd love to, please count me in!

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? The flyers, all at once...!
At this rate, the foot traffic—we can do this!

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Walking around town with you has really cheered me up, little lady...
Seriously, thank you! I feel like my shop can still pull through!

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
—So yeah, here's my thanks!
Eat up!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Th-This soba is...! Look at the portion size... Just how many shrimp tempura are in here...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What the shopkeeper prepared was special tempura seiro soba,
piled so high it seemed to pierce the heavens.
This... might honestly be a bit too much.
choice_data_list: Buena, can you finish it all?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Of course! The owner put their heart into this
soba... I'm going to eat every last bite!
choice_data_list: Let's split it between the two of us and enjoy it.
...Yeah, let's take it all on ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you dig in too, bro!
Take good care of the little lady, alright?

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you dig in too, miss!
Take good care of the little lady, alright?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for helping out.
How much should I put in?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, got it.
Let's both take the shopkeeper's determination
straight to heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By sharing, Buena Vista was able
to enjoy just the right portion of soba.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Hehe, to think I'd get to eat this again
so soon... Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista completely devoured
the massive mountain of soba without leaving a single noodle...!
